info.name: CoreVault Core Banking API (Complete Edition)
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman Collection for CoreVault V1 — 100% Free & Open-Source Core Banking Engine in Rust.

Organized by domain crates:
1. Health & Infrastructure Probes
2. Authentication & Client IAM (`cv-auth`)
3. Account Management & NUBAN (`cv-account-manager` & `cv-nuban-validator`)
4. Account Controls & Liens (`cv-account-manager`)
5. Double-Entry Transfers (`cv-double-entry-engine`)
6. Platform & Jurisdiction Configuration (`cv-platform-config-parser`)
7. Audit Trail (`cv-audit`)
8. Admin Tenant & Client Governance (`cv-transaction-api`)
9. Tenant Custom PND Rules (`cv-account-manager` & `cv-transaction-api`)

item.name: 4. Account Controls & Liens (cv-account-manager)
item.description: Powered by `cv-account-manager`. Enforces compliance restrictions (`POST_NO_DEBIT`, `FROZEN`) and financial liens/holds under CBN regulations.

exec: pm.test("PND placed: debits blocked, credits permitted", function () {

request.description: Places a Post-No-Debit (PND) hold on the account. Debits are forbidden; credits remain allowed.

item.name: 5. Double-Entry Transfers (cv-double-entry-engine)
item.description: Powered by `cv-double-entry-engine`. Enforces the fundamental invariant of double-entry bookkeeping: every transaction consists of at least two posting legs where Total Debits strictly equals Total Credits in the same currency.

exec: var r = Math.random() * 16 | 0, v = c == 'x' ? r : (r & 0x3 | 0x8);

item.name: 6. Platform & Jurisdiction Configuration (cv-platform-config-parser)
item.description: Powered by `cv-platform-config-parser`. Exposes declarative multi-country rules parsed from local TOML configurations (Nigeria NUBAN/CBN rules, UK Sort Code/FCA rules) enabling country platformization.

request.description: Lists the countries currently configured in the platform.
Parses and returns the declarative TOML rules for Nigeria (NUBAN check digit, 3-tier KYC balance limits).
